## Venice Role Play Uncensored API

Venice Role Play Uncensored is a large language model by Venice, available on the Venice API as `venice-uncensored-role-play`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Optimized for creative roleplay scenarios with maximum freedom. Designed for immersive storytelling, character interactions, and open-ended creative writing.

### Venice Role Play Uncensored API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `venice-uncensored-role-play` | Standard | Private | $0.50 / $2.00 per 1M |

### Venice Role Play Uncensored specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Venice |
| Released | Feb 20, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 128K tokens |
| Max output | 4K tokens |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the Venice Role Play Uncensored API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "venice-uncensored-role-play"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "venice-uncensored-role-play",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
